acceleration.scope: Actual retail ETEX 4 setup 418140 and motion 419560, including real 44ee00 aim, 407170 angle normalization, 41bf40 polar, native atan2/sqrt and timer. Fixed acceleration vector, current-angle/aim sentinels, retained vector Z, zero/negative/one/60-frame durations, three rates, scalar speed then vector-derived speed and direction. Sound delivery is controlled. This helper proof does not verify full concurrent-transform scheduling, animation, gameplay collisions or complete trajectories.

turn.scope: Actual retail ETEX 8 setup 418140 and motion 419970, including real polar and timers. Raw speed/angular increments, two bounded angle normalizations, retained velocity Z and unused vector fields, durations -1/0/1/60, three rates including the timer near-one branch, and index-dependent sound delivery. Sound is controlled. Full transform scheduling, collision, animation and GPU pixels are outside this helper proof.

speed-ramp.scope: Actual retail ETEX 0x200000 setup 418140 and motion 419780. Target-derived scalar increment, retained vector Z, current-angle/aim sentinels, zero/negative/one/60-frame durations, three rates and actual aim/normalization/polar/atan2/timer execution. Scalar speed is retained independently of vector magnitude. Sound is controlled; full concurrent scheduling, collision, animation and GPU pixels are outside this helper proof.

bounce.scope: Actual retail ETEX 0x40 setup 418140 and bounce 41a1a0 with real four wall consumers 419d90/419ed0/41a000/41a0d0. All 64 wall/control masks, ordinary/custom/manager override bounds, exact edge inclusion, corners, large angles, retained fields, speed sentinels, bounce counts and single sound per update. Sound is controlled. Complete scheduling, collisions, animation and GPU pixels remain outside this helper proof.

step.scope: Actual retail ETEX 10 setup 418140 and motion 419ae0: all seven modes plus out-of-range mode, speed sentinels, saved position/angle, random sentinels, original RNG execution, repeated stop/turn cycles, zero/negative/one/30-frame durations, three rates, retained velocity Z and timer completion. Sound is controlled; scheduling, collision, ANM and pixels are outside this helper proof.

size.scope: Retail ETEX 400000 setup 418140 and unmodified size update block 416781..4167c4, including real 414140 interpolation and 4041a0 easing: all 32 modes, three rates, zero/negative/one/30-frame durations, three endpoint pairs, timer expiry, retained current value and scale flag clearing. Full collision, draw and GPU equivalence are outside this helper proof.

draw-prep.scope: Retail primary bullet draw preparation block 41734a..4173ec compared with actual BulletManager::draw_group. Verifies XYZ copy, rotation normalization/dirty flag, scale dirty flag, preserved ANM base scale and replacement of extra scale over 120 flag/angle/scale combinations. Native stops before GPU dispatch; WASM uses an invisible VM. This verifies preparation, not GPU pixels, culling or secondary ANM.

state.scope: TH14 spawn and transforms 1/2/4/8/10/40/200/200000/400000/800000, concurrent acceleration/speed-ramp/turn/bounce and sequential completion, collision-delay/group/jump controls, wait/freeze countdowns, all seven stop/turn modes, saved position/angle and shared visual RNG state, primary appearance switching across all 43 types with optional interrupt, 32 size interpolation modes, timers, movement and scaled offscreen lifetime. Native ANM initialization/binding/update and collision are explicit controlled boundaries; WASM uses a fixed stop script, sprite dimensions and no-hit collision adapter. Native gameplay collision, secondary ANM, other transforms and GPU pixels remain unverified.
